notes: Catalan weather queries synthesised by BSC's Text Mining Unit (Projecte AINA) from CCMA weather-service data — 'instruction' column only (question about weather at a place/time); 'context'/'response' are for the source dataset's own text-generation task and unused here. No per-intent annotation exists, only the fact that every row is a weather query, so this is a domain-level probe: every row's reference is the constant domain label 'weather' (reference_granularity='domain'), scored via the domain part of a 'skill_id:intent_name'-shaped prediction — exercises the domain stage of adapt-domain-medium / linha-fina-domain-medium / palavreado-hierarchical-medium against real (if synthetic) Catalan phrasing outside the intents-for-eval taxonomy's own weather intents. Uses the test split reported by the datasets-server parquet conversion (num_rows_total=4598); the source README's own split counts (test.json: 1279) describe the raw jsonl files before HF's auto parquet conversion and don't match — a known upstream quirk, not an arena bug.
